email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the RIAT Digital Service Design Officer position at the Return and Reintegration Facility. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and a strong focus on user-centered design, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to the continued development of the Reintegration Assistance Tool.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills in translating user needs into actionable requirements, conducting technical audits, and coordinating with cross-functional teams. My experience building and optimizing WordPress sites, implementing structured data, and improving search visibility has given me a solid foundation in digital service design principles. I am particularly drawn to the collaborative nature of this role, working with EU Member States, Frontex, and end users to ensure RIAT meets operational needs.

I am eager to bring my analytical mindset, attention to detail, and passion for improving digital services to the RRF team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support the RIAT development.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the RIAT Digital Service Design Officer position at the Return and Reintegration Facility. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and a strong focus on user-centered design, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to the continued development of the Reintegration Assistance Tool (RIAT).

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed a robust skill set in translating user needs into actionable requirements, conducting technical audits, and coordinating with cross-functional teams. My work involves on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site builds, where I have learned to balance user experience with technical constraints. This experience has given me a solid foundation in digital service design principles, which I am eager to apply to the RIAT platform.

One of my key projects, mirook.com, involved designing and building a multi-page WordPress site from scratch. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project required iterative testing and refinement, demonstrating my ability to conduct discovery activities and translate findings into clear specifications—skills directly relevant to the RIAT role.

I am particularly drawn to the collaborative nature of this position, working with EU Member States, Frontex, and end users within the established governance framework. My experience in coordinating with developers and stakeholders, combined with my analytical mindset, positions me well to support the intake, prioritisation, and delivery preparation processes.

I am eager to bring my technical expertise and user-centric approach to the RRF team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support the continued improvement of RIAT.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core skills
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score

## Education
- Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp — Coursework in Applied Computer Science (2022–2025)
- Celal Bayar University, Türkiye — Coursework in Computer Science (2012–2016)
